verificationMethod: Photo-verified via supervisor tablet every visit; scored monthly during Facility Benchmark Audit.

zones.label: Entry & Reception
zones.summary: First-impression surfaces where patients, tenants, and visitors judge facility hygiene within 10 seconds.

points.title: Interior & exterior entry door glass full-height degrease
points.standard: Zero fingerprints, push-plate smudges, or streak lines visible at a 45-degree daylight angle up to 84 inches.

points.title: Door thresholds, mullions, and weather-strip track vacuuming
points.standard: Aluminum door tracks cleared of grit, leaves, and compacted dust; anodizing wiped damp with neutral cleaner.

points.title: Walk-off mats vacuumed dual-direction & edges squared
points.standard: Dual-pass HEPA vacuuming; zero curled corners or trip hazards; floor underneath damp-mopped before mat reset.

points.title: Reception counter, check-in kiosk & clipboard sanitization
points.standard: EPA List N disinfectant applied with full manufacturer dwell time on transaction ledges, pens, and tablet screens.

points.title: Waiting room seating upholstery, arms & under-cushion check
points.standard: Vinyl/leather wiped with non-cracking disinfectant; fabric vacuumed with crevice tool; chair legs wiped free of scuff marks.

points.title: Directory board, ADA signage & badge reader sanitization
points.standard: Microfiber detail on suite plaques, Braille tactile dots, and security fob readers without abrasive chemicals.

points.title: Lobby baseboards, window sills & architectural ledges
points.standard: Hand-wiped damp (never feather-dusted into the air) to remove settled pollen and HVAC dust.

zones.label: Restrooms & Wet Zones
zones.summary: The #1 source of tenant and patient complaints. Color-coded microfiber isolation prevents cross-contamination.

points.title: Toilets & urinals descaled inside bowl, under rim & base flange
points.standard: Hospital-grade virucidal cleaner applied under rim, porcelain base bolts scrubbed, floor seal behind bowl sanitized.

points.title: Flush valves, stall latches & ADA grab bars disinfected
points.standard: Polished dry after disinfectant dwell time so chrome and brushed stainless show zero water spotting.

points.title: Sinks, sensor faucets, aerators & underside of vanity aprons
points.standard: Biofilm ring around drain collar and faucet base removed; soap buildup under dispenser nozzle cleared.

points.title: Mirrors cleaned edge-to-edge including bottom channel
points.standard: Zero lint or splash marks from bottom frame to top edge; checked with overhead restroom lighting on.

points.title: Partition walls, tops of stall doors & coat hooks wiped
points.standard: Top horizontal edge of partitions dusted damp; both sides of stall doors degreased around latch zone.

points.title: Paper towel, tissue, seat cover & soap dispensers restocked & logged
points.standard: Spare rolls placed correctly, dispenser exteriors sanitized, low-inventory threshold flagged on visit report.

points.title: Sanitary napkin receptacles emptied, disinfected & relined
points.standard: Interior sprayed with hospital disinfectant, dried, and fitted with fresh wax/poly liner every single visit.

points.title: Floor drain trap priming & grout-line enzymatic scrub
points.standard: Water/enzyme solution poured into floor drains to block sewer gas odors; grout around urinals scrubbed.

points.title: Exhaust vent grilles vacuumed & restroom door kickplates polished
points.standard: Ceiling exhaust louvers free of gray lint buildup; stainless kickplates wiped clean of shoe marks.

zones.label: Breakroom & Kitchenette
zones.summary: Food-contact surfaces cleaned with green-coded cloths that never enter restrooms or clinical zones.

points.title: Countertops, backsplashes & coffee station degreased
points.standard: Appliance cords lifted, coffee rings removed, food-safe sanitizing solution applied across all prep areas.

points.title: Sink basin, strainer basket & gooseneck faucet sanitized
points.standard: Food debris removed from strainer, stainless steel basin scoured with non-scratch pad and polished dry.

points.title: Microwave interior roof, turntable & handle degreased
points.standard: Splatter removed from upper cavity ceiling, glass turntable washed, keypad and pull handle disinfected.

points.title: Refrigerator handles, water dispenser drip tray & gasket wipe
points.standard: Rubber door seals and handles sanitized; water/ice lever and catch tray emptied and descaled.

points.title: Breakroom tables, chair tops & lower cabinet faces
points.standard: Sticky residue removed from table edges and chair backs; trash cabinet pull zone wiped free of drips.

points.title: Food-waste & recycling bins emptied, interior wiped & relined
points.standard: Exterior sides of bins checked for coffee/liquid drips; bin interior sanitized before new liner installation.

zones.label: Workspaces, Clinics & Exam Rooms
zones.summary: Zero disturbance to papers, monitors, or clinical instruments while sanitizing exposed work zones.

points.title: Cleared desk surfaces, conference tables & credenzas sanitized
points.standard: Strict 'hands-off documents' rule: open desk areas, conference tables, and chair armrests wiped with microfiber.

points.title: Clinical exam tables, dental chair bases & operatory Cabinetry
points.standard: EPA hospital-grade disinfectant with documented contact time on clinical cabinetry, light arms, and base pedals.

points.title: Classroom low tables, cubbies & nap-mat storage sanitization
points.standard: Fragrance-free, child-safe EPA DfE disinfectant applied to surfaces below 48 inches per CCL Title 22 standards.

points.title: Interior glass partitions, sidelights & conference doors
points.standard: Smudges and dry-erase ghosting removed from conference glass walls from 24 to 72 inches height.

points.title: Desk-side waste & shred-adjacent recycling collection
points.standard: All workstation bins emptied into closed collection carts; liners replaced whenever soiled or damp.

points.title: High-dusting: ceiling corners, light troffers & HVAC supply vents
points.standard: Extension microfiber dusters capture cobwebs and vent-ring soot before it drops onto desks or exam tables.

points.title: Window blinds, mullions & perimeter convector covers
points.standard: Slats dusted closed both directions; perimeter window ledges wiped clear of dead insects and dust.

zones.label: Floors, Stairs & Baseboards
zones.summary: HEPA filtration and flat-mop microfiber systems that capture fine particulates instead of spreading dirty water.

points.title: Wall-to-wall commercial HEPA vacuuming (CRI Seal of Approval)
points.standard: Backpack HEPA vacuums trap 99.97% of allergens down to 0.3 microns; slow overlapping passes on traffic lanes.

points.title: Edges, corners & under-desk knee-space crevice detailing
points.standard: Edger attachment run along baseboards, around chair casters, and underneath reception desks where rotary heads miss.

points.title: Hard-floor microfiber damp mopping with pH-neutral cleaner
points.standard: Fresh flat-mop pad per zone (never string-mop dirty bucket water) on LVT, VCT, tile, sealed concrete, and hardwood.

points.title: Carpet spot treatment for coffee, toner & tracked asphalt
points.standard: Immediate encapsulating spotter applied to fresh spills before stains set into commercial loop pile.

points.title: Stairwell treads, risers, nosings & landing corners
points.standard: Grit swept and vacuumed from rubber stair treads and metal nosings; handrail spindles wiped.

points.title: Rubber & wood cove base detail wipe
points.standard: Mop-splash marks and black heel scuffs removed from vinyl/rubber cove base along corridors.

zones.label: Touchpoints, Security & Closeout
zones.summary: High-frequency pathogen transfer points plus strict lock-up, alarm verification, and photo sign-off.

points.title: Door levers, panic bars, push plates & suite deadbolts
points.standard: Every interior and exterior handle disinfected with hospital-grade virucide on every single visit.

points.title: Light switches, dimmer sliders, thermostat panels & alarm keypads
points.standard: Damp microfiber sanitization around wall plates and shared conference room AV controls.

points.title: Elevator call buttons, cab handrails & stairwell railings
points.standard: Full-length sanitization of handrails and stainless elevator control panels in multi-story buildings.

points.title: Drinking fountains & bottle-filler stations descaled & sanitized
points.standard: Spout guard, push bar, and basin sanitized and polished free of mineral scale.

points.title: Janitor closet organization, chemical SDS binder & mop laundering
points.standard: Soiled microfiber bagged for off-site 160°F laundering; bottles labeled; SDS sheet current; sink rinsed clean.

points.title: Dumpster enclosure check, exterior doors locked & alarm armed
points.standard: Trash bags sealed inside dumpster with lid closed; all perimeter doors physically pull-tested; alarm armed.

points.title: Timestamped photo scorecard submitted before vehicle leaves lot
points.standard: Crew lead uploads required zone verification photos and flags any building maintenance issues (leaks, burnt bulbs).
